sale.views module

sale.views.add_product_by_barcode(request)[fuente]

Adds a product to the cart by reading POST fields used in your form.

Parámetros:

request – HttpRequest with POST

Devuelve:

Redirect to sales with status message.

Raises:

ValueError if validations fail.

sale.views.add_qty(request, id_product)[fuente]

Increases by one the quantity of a product already present in the cart.

Parámetros:

  • request – HttpRequest POST only).

  • id_product – Product PK to increment in the cart.

Devuelve:

Redirect to “sales” with a status message.

Raises:

ValueError (messaged) if stock is insufficient.

sale.views.dec_qty(request, id_product)[fuente]

Decreases by one the quantity of a product; removes it if it reaches zero.

Parámetros:

  • request – HttpRequest (POST only).

  • id_product – Product PK to decrement in the cart.

Devuelve:

Redirect to “sales” with info message.

Raises:

sale.views.make_a_sale(request)[fuente]

Completes the sale, delegating all business logic to services: - Validates active inventory period and open cash session. - Verifies non-expired stock per item and consumes lots/inventory. - Registers cash movements. - Generates PDF bytes for the invoice.

Parámetros:

request – HttpRequest

Devuelve:

HttpResponse PDF download .

Raises:

ValueError for validation/stock errors.

sale.views.remove_product_from_cart(request, id_product)[fuente]

Removes a product from the cart regardless of current quantity.

Parámetros:

  • request – HttpRequest (POST only).

  • id_product – Product PK to remove from the cart.

Devuelve:

Redirect to “sales” with info message.

Raises:
